content:
incident-bot: Pager - PD:INC-98765 - High 5xx/error-rate from inference pool (us-east-1a). Metrics: 5xx spike, p99 latency jump. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/az-network
maria: Oncall, taking. what's the impact? :eyes:
raj: seeing ENI reset counts + RX queue stalls on g5 nodes in us-east-1a. Kernel dmesg shows repeated `NETDEV WATCHDOG` and `econnreset` in sidecar logs.
raj: logs:
```
May 14 08:02:11 host-az1a kernel: NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0 (nvme): transmit timed out
2026-05-14T08:02:12.345Z sidecar: connection reset to model-runtime (id=svc-rt-42) err=econnreset
```
lucas: confirmed. ENI RX queue saturation -> kernel tx path backs up. NLB health checks failing intermittently. suspect noisy tenant or NIC offload bug on g5x driver.
maria: OK plan: 1) drain problematic instances from inference pool 2) steer new traffic away from az1a -> az1b/az1c 3) update status page
kevin: I'll start drain jobs. Using internal tool: `fleetctl drain --pool inference-us-east-1a --mode graceful --max-retry 3`
kevin: starting now, will detach from NLB targets after in-flight completes.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift job 5732 started by kevin. target zones: us-east-1b, us-east-1c
raj: while draining, we should also bump failover weights in our smart-routing: `routingctl set-az-weight --az us-east-1a 0.1 --reason "ENI RX saturation"`
lucas: doing that, pushing to edge routing. Also request to infra: increase DNS TTL to 30s? shorter TTL helps but we want clients to re-resolve fast. Route53 TTL currently 300s.
maria: set TTL to 30s for the inference endpoint DNS. support-julie, can you draft initial customer message? we have sustained latency and 5xx for some hosted customers.
support-julie: drafting. Customers on Dedicated with pinned single-AZ capacity could be impacted. Noting 3 Dedicated customers with traffic in az1a. Will DM affected accounts.
raj: quick mitigation: reprovision a small warm pool in us-east-1b with compatible model variant (quantized) to accept spillover. starting template: `infra-templates/ml-small-quant`.
kevin: drain progress: 7/24 instances drained, NLB target deregisters are healthy. error rate on service is down ~40% since start.
incident-bot: Alert update - error rate decreased from 2k/min to 800/min. p95 latency still elevated.
maria: escalate to SEV2. Impact: hosted API high error rate for a subset of traffic routed to us-east-1a; Dedicated customers with single-AZ placement may see increased latency or 5xx. Public status: partial degradation for inference in us-east-1.
raj: noticed a flapping NIC on host-az1a-17. plan to isolate: mark host as quarantined and collect full logs. `inventoryctl set-host-state host-az1a-17 quarantine --tags enic-flap`
lucas: infra confirmed noisy neighbor not at hypervisor, looks like driver-level bug on a subset of instances. Raising a support ticket with cloud vendor and scheduling kernel update for the image.
maria: action items:
- kevin: finish draining remaining 17 instances and replace with healthy subfleet (ETA 20m)
- raj: collect full network traces + handoff to oncall after 30m
- lucas: open vendor support, prepare AMI rebuild with updated kernel
- support-julie: publish status page update and contact Dedicated customers
kevin: drain completed for 24/24, new subfleet healthy. steering change reduced 5xx to ~150/min. continuing monitoring.
support-julie: status updated: "Partial degradation for inference in us-east-1; traffic being rerouted; engineers investigating."
raj: capturing final logs and attaching to ticket. evidence: 3 hosts showed sustained `rx_dropped` counters and handshake failures.
maria: handing off to raj for oncall watch. raj, you're primary for the next 2 hours. If error rate remains <200/min, we'll downgrade and close.
raj: taking handoff. will keep monitoring and follow up with vendor. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident PD:INC-98765 updated to status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline recorded.
maria: thanks team. Postmortem assigned to lucas. expected writeup in 48h. closing slack thread to reduce noise.
